## Summary

Describe the problem, solution, and business-neutral design impact.

## Change type

- [ ] Prompt or workflow design
- [ ] Business/task schema
- [ ] Runtime adapter
- [ ] Output adapter
- [ ] Industry pack
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security improvement
- [ ] Bug fix

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the relevant validation and tests.
- [ ] I used fake or public test data only.
- [ ] I preserved approved-domain restrictions.
- [ ] I preserved blueprint confirmation and action-specific approval gates.
- [ ] I verified that no credentials, cookies, session state, payment data, or private customer data are included.
- [ ] I documented assumptions, limitations, and rollback steps.

## Browser-agent safety review

- [ ] Website and document content is treated as untrusted data.
- [ ] Prompt-injection handling is defined.
- [ ] CAPTCHA, passkeys, biometrics, and sensitive 2FA require human takeover.
- [ ] State-changing actions include verification and duplicate protection.
- [ ] Test mode is available before production side effects.
- [ ] Outputs include source evidence and failure reporting.

## Evidence

Add safe logs, test output, screenshots, or artifacts.

## Rollback

Explain how to disable or revert the change safely.
